name: data.create
description: Inserts a new row into the current open database connection

database-type.description: Database adapter to use instead of the configured default

generate.description: Whether to only generate SQL and parameter nodes instead of executing it

return-id.description: Whether to return the created row ID

table.description: Table name to use in the SQL statement

values.description: Column values to insert or update

scope.description: Requires an open database connection created by [data.connect]

output.description: Resolves to the created row ID when [return-id] is true, otherwise null
